why: Tests round 5 for lead tooling slice lint-dead-test-support, branch fabrikalfa/lint-dead-test-support, from b6abfb3. The build's code-graph patch could not be committed by the build (patches/**, pnpm-lock.yaml are exam paths), so this step landed it. The patch was checked by hand against the old one (0054): its old hunks are unchanged except their new-side line numbers, which move by 5, and the index line's new blob hash; its only new hunks are judge (a test-support file's export is withheld only when it is a test file or another file names it) and isCandidate (only a test file is skipped, so a test-support symbol reaches usedElsewhere). The file was copied into patches/@demlik__code-graph@0.15.0.patch and pnpm install moved the lockfile's patch_hash from 9642ccde... to 2dd91ed5..., as in build1; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile then passed. pnpm-workspace.yaml is unchanged. With the patch, lint:dead reported 14 new findings, each checked by hand (0006, 0524, no ledger entry). Twelve were exports used only inside their own file, and their export was dropped: next/apps/fabrika/e2e/tezgah.test-support.ts:23 WORKSPACE, :122 Drawn, :320 DomFocus, :326 domFocus, :369 foldDrawn (FoldDrawn stays exported, the fold visual test imports it); next/apps/fabrika/e2e/client-protocol.test-support.ts:41 Row, :315 Served; next/apps/fabrika/e2e/p14.test-support.ts:30 RESOURCES, :57 stopped (one-file.visual.test.ts has its own local RESOURCES and stopped); next/apps/fabrika/e2e/stored.test-support.ts:8 Instance. fixtures/next/packs/schedules/beat.ts:18 beat: the export was dropped, not declared an entry. No code reads pack.toml in next/ or today's version; the only user, next/apps/fabrika/src/scheduled-job-alarm.integration.test.ts:107-110, reads the file as text and appends 'export { beat as program };', and the app builder (next/apps/fabrika/src/build.ts:29, 56) selects the export 'program', never 'beat'. So nothing loads the name beat as an export, and the appended alias still binds the module's own beat. The test's comment at line 109, which called beat the pack's public export, now says the copy exports beat under the name the builder selects. fixtures/mutation/clamp.ts:6 Unit and :17 unit: the export was dropped from both. unit is there for mutants the typecheck rejects (return "" is not a Unit, an empty body returns nothing); both stay compile errors without the export, since the fixture's tsconfig has no noUnusedLocals and lint ignores fixtures/, and no line number moves, so packages/pipeline/src/stages/mutation/stryker.test.ts's places (clamp.ts:10, :12, :17) hold. next/apps/fabrika/e2e/chaos-revoke.worker.test-support.ts:112 Project is a real entry code-graph cannot see: chaos-revoke.integration.test.ts:304 builds this file as the Worker entry, and the runtime binds the Durable Object class by the name Project (next/apps/fabrika/alchemy.run.ts:46). It is named in node-kinds.json under a new entryExportConventions key, alchemy-durable-object-test-entry, with files 'e2e/chaos-revoke.worker.test-support.ts' (package-relative, as code-graph's conventionMatcher reads it) and exports ['Project'] only; code-graph's EntryExportConventionSchema is {files: string glob, exports: string[]}, and isEntry matches a declaration only when one of its export names is in that list, so the key names only Project in that one file. The L6 law in next/apps/fabrika/src/exam/node-kinds.test.ts then failed on the real file: 'alchemy-durable-object-test-entry: its glob e2e/chaos-revoke.worker.test-support.ts matches no file', because its homes left out every .test-support.ts file 'as code-graph classes them'. With the patch code-graph judges a test-support file's exports, so a glob's homes now leave out only code-graph's own isTestFile pattern (TEST_FILE, /\.((test|spec)(-d)?|type-test)\.tsx?$/), named UNJUDGED; bindings elsewhere keep the old wider filter. A made-up name still fails, as the plant shows. lint:dead then passed with no new finding and pruned nothing from unreachable-ledger.json.

Upstream repro, one bug, kept from build1: repository git+https://github.com/kamp-us/demlik.git (issues at https://github.com/kamp-us/demlik/issues), @demlik/code-graph 0.15.0. Title: '--unreachable withholds every export of a test-support file, even one nothing uses'. Tree: package.json {"name":"repro","private":true}; tsconfig.json {"compilerOptions":{"strict":true,"module":"nodenext","noEmit":true},"include":["src/**/*.ts"]}; src/fixtures/helpers.ts with 'export const unusedHelper = (n: number) => n + 1;' and 'export const unusedValue = 1;'; src/product.ts with 'export const unusedProduct = (n: number) => n + 1;'. No config, so the default testSupportFilePatterns apply (src/fixtures/ matches test-helper-module's (^|/)fixtures?/). Command, from the tree's root: code-graph . --unreachable --json. Actual on 0.15.0: unreachable is only src/product.ts:unusedProduct (dead); withheld is src/fixtures/helpers.ts:unusedHelper, reason test-support-surface; unusedExports is empty. Expected, and what the patch prints: unreachable is src/fixtures/helpers.ts:unusedHelper and src/product.ts:unusedProduct, both dead; withheld is empty; unusedExports is src/fixtures/helpers.ts:constant:unusedValue. Cause: judge (src/query/unreachable.ts) and isCandidate (src/query/unused-exports.ts) both skip a test-like file before any use is counted. Not filed from this box. The named branch is checked out in the main checkout, so this worktree worked on a local branch at the fetched head and pushed to fabrikalfa/lint-dead-test-support.
